project.name: Timeless Creations Rewards Program (TCRP)
project.description: Full-stack missionary encouragement, rewards dispatch, and POS redemption engine with Facebook Messenger Bot, Brevo Transactional Drips, and ImgBB CDN Storage.
project.runtime_environment: Node.js (ES Modules / ESM) on Vercel Serverless & Termux (Android arm64)

database.driver_protocol: Pure HTTPS JSON Pipeline (/v2/pipeline) without C++ native binaries

tables.missionaries: id, name, email, mission, start_date, points, referral_code, fb_sender_id, is_active, created_at
tables.bot_daily_views: sender_id, view_date, view_count (Atomic upsert, max 2 views/day)
tables.cdn_gallery: id, filename, direct_url, size_label, original_kb, compressed_kb, delete_url, created_at
tables.products: id, name, description, price, image_url, category, is_active, created_at
tables.claims: id, missionary_id, product_id, claim_code, status (pending/fulfilled/cancelled), created_at
tables.invoices: id, invoice_number, missionary_id, total_amount, points_deducted, cash_paid, cashier, created_at
tables.drip_templates: month_number (1-24), title, subject, highlight_image_url, body_html, quote, scriptural_ref
tables.drip_dispatch_logs: id, missionary_id, month_dispatched, email_to, brevo_message_id, status, created_at
tables.system_logs: id, log_level (INFO/WARN/ERROR), action_type, message, metadata_json, created_at

verification_suites.description: Core unit test suite (DB, bot formatting, rate limiting, mailer module)
Live ping test for Turso DB, Brevo API, ImgBB API, and Meta tokens
DOM structure, viewport, titles, and script assertions across 24 files
Deep vulnerability audit for race conditions, schema locks, and Meta limits
